words.sense: A substitute acting in the place of another person or thing
misconceptions: Assuming anyone at a meeting represents a group.
Confusing replacing one absent person with carrying a group's instructions.

words.sense: An authorized representative acting for a group
misconceptions: Assuming anyone at a meeting represents a group.
Ignoring who authorized the person and whose role they fill.

semantic_axes.description: A surrogate stands in for an absent person or thing; a delegate carries authority to represent a group and its interests.

edges.boundary_rule: A surrogate stands in for an absent person or thing; a delegate carries authority to represent a group and its interests.
clues_b: speaks or votes on collective behalf

misconceptions.M2: Confusing replacing one absent person with carrying a group's instructions.
misconceptions.M3: Ignoring who authorized the person and whose role they fill.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mariam's role at the graduation?

beats.text: Mariam attends in her absent brother's place and accepts his certificate for him.
beats.decisive_clue: fills the place of one absent individual
beats.reason: The initial evidence is fills the place of one absent individual; it best supports surrogate.

beats.text: She later carries the certificate directly to him.
beats.decisive_clue: acts in place of the named absent person
beats.reason: Delivering the certificate completes the replacement role; she speaks for no group.

chains.feedback_short: Delivering the certificate completes the replacement role; she speaks for no group.
chains.feedback_deep: Surrogate means stand-in or replacement; delegate means group representative with a mandate. Delivering the certificate completes the replacement role; she speaks for no group.
chains.contrast_rule: A surrogate fills someone's place; a delegate carries a group's voice.
